verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs explicitly state ODC instances are priced hourly but billed in one-minute increments, and a usage page shows per-instance billing detail (lambda-labs-docs-10, lambda-labs-docs-20). A real-world community billing incident (391 hours billed at ~$1.49/hr) corroborates that billing tracks running time precisely, confirming the mechanism works as documented, even though it also shows no automatic idle-shutdown protection. Missing for 10: confirmation of true per-second (not just per-minute) granularity, and independent third-party billing audits beyond the one HN anecdote.
